note: Automation manifest for DVMA. IDs mirror lib/core/test_ids.dart.

modules.title: Clipboard Leakage of Sensitive Fields
modules.manualTest: copy a sensitive field, then read the clipboard from a second app / `adb shell` and confirm the secret is present.

modules.title: Insecure Backups (allowBackup / unencrypted iOS backups)
modules.manualTest: run `adb backup` (or a Finder/iMazing backup) and confirm app data is recoverable from the backup.

modules.title: Insecure Local Storage (Plaintext SharedPreferences/UserDefaults)
modules.manualTest: pull `shared_prefs/*.xml` (Android) or the app's `NSUserDefaults` plist (iOS) via `adb`/objection and confirm the token/SSN/card are cleartext.

modules.title: Insecure SD-Card / External Storage
modules.manualTest: read the app's file from shared / external storage with a second app or `adb`.

modules.title: Screenshot / Task-Switcher Leakage
modules.manualTest: background the app on a sensitive screen and inspect the task-switcher snapshot.

modules.title: Sensitive Data in Crash Reports
modules.manualTest: trigger a crash and confirm the crash payload shipped to the crash service contains secrets/PII/request bodies; verify the secure build scrubs/allowlists the crash payload before sending.

modules.title: Sensitive Data in Logs
modules.manualTest: `adb logcat` / `idevicesyslog` while using the app; confirm PII/tokens are logged.

modules.title: Authentication-State Rollback / Restore
modules.manualTest: restore a stale session/token blob (old backup/snapshot) and confirm the app revives the ended/revoked session; verify the secure build validates freshness/revocation server-side and rejects the rolled-back state.

modules.title: Keyboard Cache & Autofill Leakage
modules.manualTest: type into a sensitive field, then inspect the IME's personalized-dictionary / autofill cache and confirm the secret was retained (field not marked no-suggestions / no-autofill).

modules.title: Keychain/Keystore Misuse
modules.manualTest: dump the Keychain with objection / `keychain-dumper` and confirm weak accessibility / no hardware backing.

modules.title: Local Security-State Integrity Tampering
modules.manualTest: edit a UserDefaults / SharedPreferences / SQLite value that gates a security decision (role / entitlement) and confirm the app trusts it; verify the secure build binds the value to a keyed MAC / server authority and rejects the edit.

modules.title: Temp / Cache File Leftovers
modules.manualTest: browse the app cache/temp dirs and confirm sensitive leftovers.

modules.title: Third-Party SDK Data Leakage
modules.manualTest: proxy traffic with mitmproxy and confirm the SDK exfiltrates more than its stated purpose.

modules.title: Backup Archive Integrity Tampering
modules.manualTest: pull a backup, flip a persisted flag (e.g. `is_premium`/`is_admin`) or a balance, re-pack, restore, and confirm the app trusts the tampered state; verify the secure build verifies a keyed MAC over the archive and rejects it (CVE-2025-49199, MASTG-BEST-0065).

modules.title: Keychain Access-Group Authorization Confusion
modules.manualTest: from a different access group / extension read items stored under an over-broad or wildcard `kSecAttrAccessGroup` and confirm cross-group access; verify the secure build scopes items to an exact app-private group and refuses the read (iOS Keychain authorization CVE-2026-28864 class).

modules.title: Keychain State Integrity Manipulation
modules.manualTest: modify a Keychain/Keystore item the app treats as authoritative (e.g. a trust flag/signing key) and confirm the app acts on the tampered value; verify the secure build verifies an integrity tag/attestation and rejects it (iOS Keychain state-modification CVE-2026-28860 class).

modules.title: Sensitive Data in Memory
modules.manualTest: dump the process memory (fridump / objection / gdb) and recover the retained password/key.

modules.title: Hardcoded Keys & Static IVs
modules.manualTest: `strings`/jadx the binary and recover the key/IV.

modules.title: Weak Cryptographic Algorithms (MD5/SHA1/DES/RC4/ECB)
modules.manualTest: `strings`/jadx the binary and confirm a broken primitive (DES/RC4/MD5/SHA-1/ECB) is used; capture ciphertext and show the structural weakness (e.g. ECB pattern leakage).

modules.title: Custom / Homegrown Crypto
modules.manualTest: reverse the hand-rolled cipher with jadx/Ghidra and confirm it is trivially reversible (XOR / rolled AES) vs a platform primitive.

modules.title: Device Secure Lock Not Enforced for Sensitive Storage
modules.manualTest: run the app on a device with no screen lock and confirm sensitive features/keys are still available (no `setUserAuthenticationRequired` / secure-lock gate).

modules.title: Improper MAC Verification (non-constant-time / unauthenticated)
modules.manualTest: flip a byte in an authenticated payload and confirm it is accepted (no constant-time MAC compare / MAC not checked).

modules.title: Insecure Randomness (predictable tokens/session IDs)
modules.manualTest: sample the "random" token/nonce/OTP repeatedly and confirm it is predictable (java.util.Random / non-CSPRNG seed).

modules.title: RSA Without OAEP Padding
modules.manualTest: confirm RSA uses PKCS#1 v1.5 (not OAEP) and demonstrate the padding-oracle distinguisher against the decrypt endpoint.

modules.title: Unauthenticated Encryption (malleable ciphertext / bit-flipping)
modules.manualTest: bit-flip AES-CBC ciphertext (no MAC) and confirm the corresponding plaintext bit flips on decrypt (malleable / no integrity).

modules.title: Weak Key Derivation (no/low PBKDF2 iterations)
modules.manualTest: capture the derived material and crack with hashcat given the low/absent iteration count.

modules.title: Improper Signature Verification (payload not bound)
modules.manualTest: tamper a signed blob/update and confirm it is accepted (signature skipped or wrong key/no chain check).

modules.title: Developer Backdoor
modules.manualTest: decompile with jadx / `strings` and recover the hardcoded backdoor credential or debug route.

modules.title: Username Enumeration
modules.manualTest: compare login responses for valid vs invalid usernames and confirm they differ.

modules.title: Weak / No Password Policy
modules.manualTest: register/change password to a trivial value (`123456`, `password`) and confirm it is accepted (no length/complexity/breach check).

modules.title: Client-Side-Only Authorization
modules.manualTest: flip the client-side admin flag with Frida/objection and confirm privileged actions unlock.

modules.title: Cross-App OTP / Credential Leak
modules.manualTest: from a second (unprivileged) app, read the OTP / `myauth://` auth deep link this app publishes on an unprotected exported component/broadcast/clipboard (Authenticator CVE-2026-26123 class); confirm an allowlisted/signature-checked channel yields nothing.

modules.title: Deep Link Authentication Bypass
modules.manualTest: fire a deep link (e.g. `dvma://wallet`) via adb while logged out and confirm it reaches the authenticated screen without the app-lock/login gate (Groww CVE-2026-12065 class).

modules.title: Insecure / Bypassable Biometric Prompt
modules.manualTest: hook the auth callback with Frida and force the success path.

modules.title: Insecure Credential Manager / Autofill Integration
modules.manualTest: confirm a credential is associated with an unverified domain (no Digital Asset Links / AASA) and autofills into an insecure field.

modules.title: Insecure Password Reset Token / Magic Link
modules.manualTest: request multiple reset tokens/magic links and confirm they are short, related/predictable, and never expire.

modules.title: JWT Vulnerabilities (alg:none, weak secret)
modules.manualTest: forge an `alg:none` token / crack the weak secret with `jwt_tool` and confirm acceptance.

modules.title: Multi-Account Isolation Failure
modules.manualTest: log into account A, switch to / log into account B, and confirm A's cached token/data is still readable (and A's session survives logout); verify the secure build scopes per-account state to the active principal and wipes/rotates it on switch and logout.

modules.title: Passkey Credential Exfiltration
modules.manualTest: pull the credential store off-device and confirm private-key material is present.

modules.title: Passkey Registration/Deletion Authorization Missing
modules.manualTest: call the register/delete passkey endpoint as a different user and confirm you can add your own passkey or delete the victim's (account takeover / lockout; USENIX 2026 class).

modules.title: Passkey Fallback / Downgrade Attack
modules.manualTest: force "passkey unavailable" and confirm the weak fallback path is accepted.

modules.title: Session Fixation After WebAuthn Assertion
modules.manualTest: set a known pre-auth session id, complete a passkey assertion, and confirm the id is not rotated afterwards.

modules.title: Passkey Weak / No Attestation Verification
modules.manualTest: register with `none` attestation via a WebAuthn test harness and confirm acceptance.

modules.title: Weak Session Management
modules.manualTest: capture the session token and confirm it is predictable / never rotated on privilege change / never expires (replay it after logout).

modules.title: Biometric Result Not Bound to Operation
modules.manualTest: capture a biometric success for operation A and replay it to authorize operation B (the boolean isn't tied to the operation), and overlay the prompt; verify the secure build binds the result to a per-operation signed challenge (CryptoObject) so it only authorizes the exact op (Android biometric-overlay CVE-2025-48528 class).

modules.title: Credential Provider Release Authorization Failure
modules.manualTest: from a spoofed calling app / with an rpId mismatch (and no user-verification) extract a stored credential/passkey and enumerate entries; verify the secure build binds the calling app to the rpId, requires UV, and refuses enumeration (credential- provider release-boundary class).

modules.title: Identity Credential / mDL Presentation Not Bound
modules.manualTest: replay a captured mDL/mDoc (Identity Credential / ISO 18013-5) or Wallet identity presentation from a different session and confirm the verifier accepts it on issuer signature alone; verify the secure build binds the device signature to this session's transcript + reader nonce and requires fresh user presence.

modules.title: OAuth Misconfiguration (implicit flow token leakage)
modules.manualTest: capture the implicit-flow token from the redirect/logs under mitmproxy.

modules.title: Passkey Assertion Replay (Sign-Count Not Enforced)
modules.manualTest: capture a WebAuthn assertion and replay it; confirm it is accepted again because the sign-count/credential counter is never compared (Craft CMS CVE-2026-72780 class).

modules.title: Passkey Challenge Reuse / Not Bound
modules.manualTest: record an assertion for the server's challenge and replay it; confirm the static/reused challenge accepts it.

modules.title: Passkey Origin / RP-ID Binding Bypass
modules.manualTest: assert from an origin that merely contains the rpId and confirm acceptance.

modules.title: Passkey Step-Up Authentication Bypass
modules.manualTest: trigger a sensitive action and confirm step-up is marked "verified" from a registered passkey without completing an assertion (New-API AI gateway CVE-2026-32879 class).

modules.title: Third-Party Authenticator / Cross-Device Pairing Authorization Missing
modules.manualTest: approve a third-party authenticator / cross-device pairing and confirm no permission check gates it (Android CVE-2025-48640 / BLE CVE-2026-65935 class).

modules.title: Passkey User-Verification (UV) Enforcement Bypass
modules.manualTest: submit an assertion with the UV flag unset under a `userVerification=REQUIRED` policy and confirm it is accepted (Spring Security CVE-2026-47841 class).

modules.title: Cleartext Traffic Allowed
modules.manualTest: confirm plain HTTP under mitmproxy.

modules.title: Accept-All TrustManager
modules.manualTest: confirm any cert is accepted under MITM.

modules.title: Insecure WebView Networking
modules.manualTest: confirm mixed/cleartext content loads.

modules.title: Weak / Outdated TLS Config
modules.manualTest: run `testssl.sh` against the endpoint.

modules.title: SSL Pinning (Trivially Bypassable)
modules.manualTest: bypass pinning with objection/Frida and MITM.

modules.title: Activity-Alias Exposure
modules.manualTest: launch a protected Activity through an `<activity-alias>` that is `exported=true` / lacks the target permission; verify the secure alias echoes the target's protection and refuses the external caller.

modules.title: Missing FLAG_SECURE (screen recording exposure)
modules.manualTest: `adb shell screenrecord` a sensitive screen.

modules.title: Over-Privileged Permissions
modules.manualTest: review the manifest with aapt/jadx.

modules.title: Over-Broad Media Access (no scoped photo picker)
modules.manualTest: review the manifest/Info.plist and confirm full media-library access is requested instead of the scoped photo picker.

modules.title: Predictive Back / Recents Snapshot Leakage
modules.manualTest: trigger the Android 14+ predictive-back / recents snapshot on a sensitive screen and confirm it is captured.

modules.title: Push Notification Leakage
modules.manualTest: inspect notification payloads / lockscreen.

modules.title: QR Scanner -> URL With No Validation
modules.manualTest: scan a QR encoding a `javascript:` or privileged `dvma://` payload and confirm it is opened/navigated with no validation (Firefox iOS QR-scanner CVE-2025-54145 class).

modules.title: App Clip Invocation Injection
modules.manualTest: craft an App Clip invocation URL (or spoof the QR/NFC trigger) that performs a purchase/account action and confirm it inherits full-app auth; verify the secure build validates the invocation against the associated domain and re-authenticates sensitive actions.

modules.title: Background Activity Launch Abuse
modules.manualTest: from a background caller drive a component to `startActivity()` onto a security-sensitive/consent surface and confirm the phishing/task-hijack UI appears; verify the secure build enforces BAL (foreground or valid launch token) and refuses the launch (Android CVE-2025-26462 class).

modules.title: Clipboard Unauthorized Write / Integrity Tampering
modules.manualTest: from untrusted content (a page in the app WebView / another app) overwrite the system clipboard with no user gesture and confirm the user pastes attacker-controlled data (e.g. a swapped crypto address); verify the secure build requires a trusted origin + user gesture (Lenovo Android web-to-clipboard CVE-2026-7516 class).

modules.title: ClipData URI-Grant Leakage
attackInputs: crafted intent with ClipData content:// URI
modules.manualTest: fire an implicit Intent whose `ClipData` carries a private `content://` URI + `FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION` and confirm a co-resident resolver can read the private data; verify the secure build sends explicit intents and never grants on untrusted-resolver ClipData.

modules.title: ContentProvider File-Import Filename Path Traversal
modules.manualTest: import a file whose display name is `../../shared_prefs/secrets.xml` and confirm it escapes the import dir and overwrites/reads an app file; verify the secure build canonicalizes and confines the path under the import root (Android ContentProvider import traversal CVE-2025-65814 / CVE-2025-65815 class).

modules.title: Custom / Signature Permission Squatting
attackInputs: co-resident app that defines/holds the custom permission
modules.manualTest: protect an IPC component with a `normal`-level custom permission (or define the permission name first from a malicious app) and confirm the guard is trivially held; verify the secure build uses `signature` protection and checks the caller's signing identity.

modules.title: Custom URL Scheme Authorization (arbitrary URL load)
modules.manualTest: `adb shell am start`/`xcrun simctl openurl` a `dvma://open?url=https://attacker.example` and confirm the app loads the attacker site with no caller/allowlist check (Rakuten CVE-2024-41918 / @cosme CVE-2024-45203 / Groww CVE-2026-12065 class).

modules.title: Deep Link -> Trusted WebView Navigation
modules.manualTest: send a deep link whose `url` param points off-origin (or `javascript:`/`file://`) and confirm it loads in the trusted WebView with no origin allowlist (TikTok CVE-2024-45240 / Rakuten CVE-2024-41918 / EcoOnline CVE-2026-26897 class).

modules.title: Deep Link / URL Scheme Hijack
modules.manualTest: fire crafted deep links with `adb`.

modules.title: Default-Role / Role-Holder Confusion
attackInputs: malicious app claiming the role intent-filter
modules.manualTest: register a co-resident app for the role intent-filter (browser/dialer/SMS/wallet), confirm the app delegates a secret to whatever `resolveActivity()` returns; verify the secure build checks the actual RoleManager holder and pins package + signature.

modules.title: Document Picker -> Trusted-File Confusion
modules.manualTest: return a document from the system picker whose declared type/path is hostile (mislabeled type, a path into a privileged location) and confirm the app trusts it into a sensitive sink; verify the secure build re-validates real content/type and confines the path (Document Picker / security-scoped-URL trust class).

modules.title: Dynamic BroadcastReceiver Exposure
modules.manualTest: from a co-resident app, send a crafted broadcast to a receiver registered at runtime without `RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED` / a signature permission and confirm the sensitive action fires; verify the secure build registers not-exported and drops it.

modules.title: Exported Android Components
modules.manualTest: enumerate/invoke with drozer.

modules.title: Exported Component -> Arbitrary URL / Activity Launch
modules.manualTest: via drozer/adb, deliver an external intent naming an attacker URL / internal activity and confirm it opens with the app's identity (ABEMA CVE-2024-28745 / Samsung Members CVE-2026-20985 & CVE-2025-21079 class).

modules.title: Exported Component -> Unauthorized State Manipulation
modules.manualTest: from a `com.evil.*` app, send the exported component an intent naming the victim's notification id and confirm it is cancelled with no ownership check; verify the secure build requires owner==caller (or a signature permission) and refuses the cross-owner mutation (Datadog Android CVE-2026-47361 class).

modules.title: Handoff / NSUserActivity Injection
modules.manualTest: hand off a crafted `NSUserActivity` whose `userInfo` targets another account's resource and confirm the receiving app applies it; verify the secure build validates activityType, binds the activity to the authenticated account, and treats userInfo as untrusted.

modules.title: Implicit Intent Leaks Sensitive Data
modules.manualTest: register a receiver in a second app for the same action and confirm sensitive extras sent on an implicit intent are delivered to it (Samsung Smart View CVE-2025-21024 class); confirm an explicit (packaged) send does not leak.

modules.title: In-App Browser UI / Address-Bar Spoofing
modules.manualTest: load attacker content that sets a fake title/origin and confirm the in-app browser address bar shows a trusted origin while the real committed URL is the attacker's (Firefox Focus CVE-2025-10290 / LINE CVE-2024-5739 class).

modules.title: Incoming-Call Metadata Read (Missing Authorization class)
modules.manualTest: from an unprivileged app read/observe incoming-call metadata (number/state) via the exported surface with no permission check and confirm it is disclosed.

modules.title: Notification-Action / Trampoline Authorization Bypass
modules.manualTest: trigger a notification action (Android trampoline receiver→activity / iOS UNNotificationAction) that approves a transfer with no fresh auth; verify the secure build routes every surface through the same authorization check and re-auths destructive actions.

modules.title: Notification Listener Authorization Bypass
modules.manualTest: bind a notification listener with no recorded user grant (above lock / unverified filter) and read all notification contents; verify the secure build requires a persisted grant recorded while unlocked and a verified listener component (Android CVE-2025-22427 / CVE-2025-26442 class).

modules.title: Ordered-Broadcast Result Injection
modules.manualTest: register a higher-priority receiver that rewrites the result via `setResultData()` / `abortBroadcast()` and confirm the app trusts the poisoned result; verify the secure build guards the broadcast with a signature permission and never trusts ordered-broadcast results for security decisions.

modules.title: Overlay Phishing
modules.manualTest: draw an overlay over the credential screen with a PoC app and confirm input can be captured / the tap is obscured.

modules.title: Platform-Version Security Fallback
modules.manualTest: run on an OS below the feature threshold and confirm the `if (SDK_INT >= X)` guard silently drops to an insecure path (no hardware key backing); verify the secure gate fails closed on the unsupported OS.

modules.title: QR Code Injection
modules.manualTest: scan a crafted QR and confirm unvalidated action.

modules.title: SSRF via URL / Media Handler
modules.manualTest: pass an internal/loopback/metadata URL (`http://169.254.169.254/...`) to the media/URL loader and confirm the app fetches it; verify the secure build allowlists public hosts only (WhatsApp iOS CVE-2026-23866 class).

modules.title: Tapjacking
modules.manualTest: overlay a PoC app and confirm the tap passes through.

modules.title: AccessibilityService Privilege Abuse
modules.manualTest: from the a11y service trigger a background activity launch / UI-hide / injected gesture with no valid a11y event and confirm the privileged action fires; verify the secure build requires a user-enabled service, a genuine foreground event, and an action allowlist (Android AccessibilityServiceConnection CVE-2025-26462 / CVE-2023-21109 class).

modules.title: Activity Task-Stack / Affinity Hijacking
modules.manualTest: launch a malicious Activity that spoofs the victim's `taskAffinity` (StrandHogg-style) and confirm it appears atop the trusted task; verify the secure build uses a unique affinity and disallows reparenting so it lands in its own task.

modules.title: Android Capability-Composition Chain
modules.manualTest: trigger the notification action (or send the broadcast directly) as an untrusted caller and confirm the mutable PendingIntent → exported receiver → bound Binder service → transfer chain runs the transfer without ever re-checking the original caller; verify the secure build propagates + re-authorizes the original caller at the sink and uses immutable/explicit intents + per-method authorization.

modules.title: App Intent / Siri Parameter -> Privileged Action (No Authz)
modules.manualTest: invoke a privileged App Intent/Shortcut (transfer/export) with an untrusted parameter targeting another user's entity and confirm it runs with no authorization; verify the secure build requires a verified auth token and an ownership check (Apple App Intents capability-confusion class).

modules.title: Authorization Based on Mutable Resource State
modules.manualTest: request access using a file-existence/state pre-check, then create/replace the resource and confirm you gain read/write to a file you shouldn't own (incl. not-yet-existing files); verify the secure build binds authorization to a stable owner captured atomically (Android MediaProvider CVE-2026-0035 class).

modules.title: Clipboard -> Privileged Action Injection
modules.manualTest: seed the clipboard from an untrusted origin and confirm it flows into a privileged action (auto-paste into a payment/command field / automation step) with no validation; verify the secure build validates/allowlists the value and requires explicit confirmation (webpage → clipboard → automation → privileged capability; CVE-2026-17766 class).

modules.title: Confused-Deputy Intent Validation Bypass
modules.manualTest: from an unprivileged app, invoke the privileged component with a superficially-valid Intent and confirm the action runs with the app's privileges (Android Settings CVE-2025-32326 / CVE-2025-32321 class).

modules.title: Blind SQLi Boolean-Oracle Extraction (Contacts-Provider class)
modules.manualTest: with drozer, send boolean/time-based `selection` clauses to the contacts-style provider and confirm a blind-SQLi oracle leaks rows the caller shouldn't see.

modules.title: Content Provider SQL Injection
modules.manualTest: inject via the provider with drozer.

modules.title: content:// URI -> ContentResolver Confused Deputy
modules.manualTest: hand the app an attacker `content://com.dvma.private/...` URI in an intent extra and confirm it reads the privileged provider through its own ContentResolver and returns the data to you (confused deputy); verify the secure build validates the caller may access that authority and refuses the privileged read (Android DownloadProvider CVE-2025-26417 class).

modules.title: Cross-App Scripting (Untrusted Intent -> Exported Activity -> WebView JS)
modules.manualTest: from a co-resident app, fire an Intent whose value is a `javascript:` payload (or an attacker URL) at the exported activity and confirm it executes in the WebView's trusted origin; verify the secure build validates scheme+origin first (Google Cross-App Scripting class; Element CVE-2024-26131/26132, TikTok CVE-2024-45240).

modules.title: Cross-Profile (Work/Personal) Data & Capability Leakage
modules.manualTest: forward a work-profile credential to a personal surface (share sheet / clipboard / intent) and confirm it crosses; verify the secure build enforces a cross-profile policy (only allowlisted, non-sensitive items may cross, with the required user affordance) so work data is blocked (Android managed-profile leakage class).

modules.title: Dynamic Code Loading (Arbitrary Code Execution)
modules.manualTest: supply a malicious module/dex from a companion app or external storage and confirm it executes unverified.

modules.title: File-Descriptor Capability Leakage
modules.manualTest: bind the service and receive a `ParcelFileDescriptor` for a sensitive DB the caller couldn't open by path; verify the secure build validates the caller and only returns a read-only FD to a narrowly-scoped non-sensitive resource.

modules.title: FileProvider Path Traversal / Arbitrary File Sharing
modules.manualTest: via drozer / a companion app, request a traversal path (`../`) through the FileProvider and read an app-private file.

modules.title: URI Permission / GRANT_URI_PERMISSIONS Abuse
modules.manualTest: send a redirected Intent carrying `FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION` to a private `content://` URI and confirm the malicious app reads a file it was never granted directly (Pixel CVE-2024-27222 class).

modules.title: Insecure WebView (JS Bridge RCE, file:// access)
modules.manualTest: reach the JS bridge / `file://` and demonstrate RCE-style behavior.

modules.title: Intent Argument Injection -> Local Code Execution
modules.manualTest: with drozer/adb, invoke the exported component with a crafted extra (e.g. `-xrun`/`cmd`/`loadLibrary`) and confirm attacker-controlled args reach an execution path with the app's privileges (Unity CVE-2025-59489 class); confirm the allowlist handler rejects it.

modules.title: Intent Redirection / Task Hijack (StrandHogg-style)
modules.manualTest: send crafted extras carrying a nested intent via drozer/adb and confirm it is forwarded to an internal component.

modules.title: iOS Capability-Composition Chain
modules.manualTest: open the crafted Universal Link and confirm it drives App Intent perform() → security-scoped bookmark → Contacts export with no user authorization; verify the secure build treats the link as untrusted, requires fresh authorization at the App Intent for the protected-data action, and re-validates the bookmark scope before the sink.

modules.title: Pending Intent Hijacking
modules.manualTest: intercept the mutable PendingIntent.

modules.title: PendingIntent Provenance Confusion
modules.manualTest: obtain/replay a PendingIntent the app created and confirm the receiving SDK authenticates the presenter as the creator app (arXiv 2603.02539); confirm strict presenter==creator checking rejects it.

modules.title: Persistent URI-Grant Capability Abuse
modules.manualTest: send an exported component a `content://` URI with `FLAG_GRANT_PERSISTABLE_URI_PERMISSION`, confirm it calls `takePersistableUriPermission()` and the grant survives revocation while the provider swaps data; verify the secure build never persists untrusted grants.

modules.title: Privileged Service Binding / Binder Interface Exposure
modules.manualTest: `bindService()` from an untrusted package and call a privileged Binder method with no caller check; verify the secure build validates caller identity / a signature permission before returning a usable binder.

modules.title: Proximity Transfer Unsafe Parsing (AirDrop / Quick Share)
modules.manualTest: feed a malformed plist / deeply nested XML entity-expansion bomb as a proximity-transfer (AirDrop/Quick Share) payload and confirm the naive parser blows up (huge expansion / state confusion) with no pairing; verify the secure build caps depth, entity expansion, and size and rejects it (AirDrop & Quick Share proximity-protocol research class).

modules.title: App-Widget / RemoteViews Action Injection
modules.manualTest: supply attacker widget-config extras that populate a RemoteViews action `PendingIntent` and confirm tapping the widget runs a privileged transfer with attacker params; verify the secure build binds only immutable explicit intents and re-auths destructive ops.

modules.title: Shortcuts / App Intents Path + Symlink Sandbox Escape
modules.manualTest: drive a Shortcut/App-Intents file op with a `../` or symlinked path and confirm it resolves outside the app container to a sensitive file; verify the secure build canonicalizes and confines the real path to the container (iOS Shortcuts CVE-2026-20677 / CVE-2026-20653 class).

modules.title: System-Surface -> Privileged App Intent Exposure
modules.manualTest: fire a privileged App Intent from a surface that shouldn't be allowed to (Widget/Control/Action Button) with no unlock and confirm it runs; verify the secure build enforces per-surface authorization + auth for sensitive intents (Apple App Intents multi-surface exposure class).

modules.title: Telephony / Phone-Account Capability Abuse
modules.manualTest: from an untrusted/exported caller invoke a telephony capability (place a call to a premium number / send SMS / register a phone account) with no per-invocation permission check; verify the secure build requires the matching permission + per-invocation confirmation (Android Telecom CVE-2026-28615 class).

modules.title: Unauthenticated Local / Loopback Service
modules.manualTest: hit the app's loopback HTTP/TCP or unix-domain socket from a co-resident app or a DNS-rebinding web origin (no token) and confirm privileged data/functionality is served; verify the secure build requires a per-session token and validates the Origin/Host, rejecting rebinding + untokened callers.

modules.title: Universal Link / AASA Associated-Domain Confusion
modules.manualTest: craft a Universal Link that exploits a broad AASA path/wildcard or an open redirect to reach a sensitive handler; verify the secure build uses tight exact-path matching and re-validates params.

modules.title: WebView Untrusted URL -> Local File Read (iOS WKWebView)
modules.manualTest: inject HTML/JS into a reflected field and confirm the WebView (with file access enabled) can read the app's local files; verify the secure build escapes output and disables file access (ZOLL ePCR iOS CVE-2025-12699 class).

modules.title: Zero-Click Media Parse Before User Accept (VoIP-ring class)
modules.manualTest: deliver a crafted call/media payload that reaches the parser with no user interaction and confirm it is parsed unsafely (crash / state confusion) at the zero-click sink.

modules.title: Zip Path Traversal (Zip-Slip)
modules.manualTest: feed a zip-slip archive to the update unpacker.

modules.title: Debuggable Release Build
modules.manualTest: confirm `debuggable=true` in the release APK.

modules.title: No Obfuscation / Symbol Stripping
modules.manualTest: confirm readable symbols with jadx/`nm`.

modules.title: Verbose Error Handling (leaked stack traces)
modules.manualTest: trigger an error path (bad input, forced failure) and confirm the response/UI/log leaks a stack trace, SQL, or internal path instead of a generic message.

modules.title: Vulnerable Dependencies (known CVE)
modules.manualTest: run osv-scanner / dependency-check.

modules.title: Native Code Memory Bugs (JNI buffer overflow)
modules.manualTest: analyze the native lib in Ghidra; trigger the overflow.

modules.title: App Attestation Not Implemented (server never verifies client)
modules.manualTest: MITM the app's API and confirm no app attestation (Play Integrity / App Attest) token is required, so a repackaged/emulated client is served normally.

modules.title: Device Attestation Not Implemented (Play Integrity / App Attest)
modules.manualTest: confirm the server accepts requests with no hardware key-attestation / DeviceCheck evidence, so a rooted/emulated device is trusted.

modules.title: Emulator Detection Bypass
modules.manualTest: spoof build props and bypass.

modules.title: Malware / Overlay Co-Resident Detection Not Implemented
modules.manualTest: install a known-bad/sideloaded companion and confirm the app performs no on-device threat check before handling secrets.

modules.title: Root/Jailbreak Detection Bypass
modules.manualTest: bypass with objection/Frida.

modules.title: App Virtualization / Cloning Detection Not Implemented
modules.manualTest: run inside an app-cloner / work- profile / virtual space and confirm the app runs with no detection of the virtualized container.

modules.title: Anti-Debugging Bypass
modules.manualTest: patch out the debugger check.

modules.title: Anti-Tampering / Integrity Bypass
modules.manualTest: modify the APK and confirm it runs.

modules.title: Frida Detection Bypass
modules.manualTest: disable the Frida string check.

modules.title: TOCTOU Race Condition in Auth Check
modules.manualTest: win the check-to-use race.

modules.title: Missing / Stale SBOM (No Component Inventory)
modules.manualTest: confirm the build produces no Software Bill of Materials; generate one (e.g. CycloneDX) and cross-reference bundled SDK versions against advisories to reveal the components that were invisible.

modules.title: Typosquatted Dependency
modules.manualTest: review pubspec for the lookalike name.

modules.title: Insecure Firebase / Cloud Backend Config
modules.manualTest: extract the Firebase/cloud URL + keys with jadx/`strings` and confirm an unauthenticated read returns other users' data (curl / mitmproxy).

modules.title: Malicious Third-Party SDK
modules.manualTest: confirm exfiltration under mitmproxy.

modules.title: Unsigned / Unverified Build Artifact
modules.manualTest: verify with `apksigner` and confirm the update path skips signature/checksum checks.

modules.title: Dependency Confusion / Substitution
modules.manualTest: confirm an internal/private package name can be resolved from a public registry (pubspec/CocoaPods/SPM), so a higher public version would be pulled over the trusted private one; confirm scoped/pinned resolution prevents it (iOS dependency-management research class).

modules.title: Bundled SDK Ships a Vulnerable Exported Component
modules.manualTest: with drozer/adb, deliver a nested "forward" intent to a bundled SDK's exported component and confirm it redirects to a private component (leaking credentials) with the host app's privileges (EngageLab SDK class); confirm the allowlisted handler refuses.

modules.title: Silent SDK Auto-Update (Post-Deploy Behavior Change)
modules.manualTest: under mitmproxy, serve a modified remote "SDK behavior" payload and confirm it is applied at runtime with no signature/checksum check, changing app behavior post-install (SpinOK-style).

modules.title: Installed-App Enumeration (Privacy Fingerprint)
modules.manualTest: confirm the app probes a broad scheme/package list (iOS `canOpenURL` / Android `queryIntentActivities`) and builds an installed-app fingerprint with no functional need; verify the secure build checks only its one declared scheme (iOS CVE-2026-20641 class).

modules.title: Missing Consent Before Data Access
modules.manualTest: confirm data access with no consent screen.

modules.title: No Tracking Transparency Prompt
modules.manualTest: confirm tracking with no ATT prompt.

modules.title: System Assistant -> Locked-Device Capability Abuse
modules.manualTest: invoke a Siri/App-Intents/voice capability on a LOCKED device and confirm it exposes sensitive info or runs a privileged action without unlocking; verify the secure build re-checks authentication for sensitive capabilities (iOS Siri locked-device CVE-2026-28856 class).

modules.title: Cross-App Browser History Access
modules.manualTest: read browsing history belonging to another app / the system browser with no consent; verify the secure build requires explicit consent and scoping (iOS CVE-2026-20656 Safari-history class).

modules.title: Lock-State Confusion Data Exposure
modules.manualTest: while the device is LOCKED, reach sensitive content/action through an accessibility / notification / widget / VoiceOver path that never re-checks the keyguard; verify the secure build re-checks lock state and redacts (iOS CVE-2026-20645 / CVE-2026-20661 class).

modules.title: Notification Content Disclosure via Alternate Surface
modules.manualTest: trigger a notification redacted on the lock screen and confirm its full content renders on a secondary surface (DeX/desktop mode, widget, companion display); verify the secure build applies the same redaction policy on every unauthenticated surface (Samsung DeX CVE-2026-21006 class).

modules.title: PII in Analytics Events
modules.manualTest: capture analytics events under mitmproxy.

modules.title: Privacy Control Alternate-Path Bypass
modules.manualTest: read protected data through an alternate path (a different API, a shared app-group container, a cached copy) that sidesteps the consent gate; verify the secure build funnels all reads through the single consent-checked accessor (iOS CVE-2026-20606 class).

modules.title: Deep Link Regex DoS (ReDoS)
modules.manualTest: send a crafted deep link that triggers catastrophic regex backtracking in link parsing and confirm the app freezes/hangs (Mattermost CVE-2024-3872 class); confirm the linear/anchored parser stays responsive.

modules.title: Unsafe Media / Image Decoding
modules.manualTest: feed a crafted image (spoofed huge dimensions / decompression bomb / unexpected format) and confirm the app decodes it with no size/type/dimension validation (Samsung CVE-2025-21043 class); confirm the safe decoder rejects it on caps + format allowlist.

modules.title: Unvalidated Intent Extras
modules.manualTest: send crafted extras with drozer/adb.

modules.title: Protected-Data Access via Input-Validation Confusion
modules.manualTest: send an evasive identifier (encoded / `..` / case / unicode variant such as `users/./admin/%2E%2E/admin/SSN`) that slips a protected id past a naive deny check and returns protected data; verify the secure build canonicalizes FIRST and checks the canonical form (Apple protected-data-via-input-sanitization CVE-2026-43714 class).

modules.title: Unsafe Deserialization
modules.manualTest: craft a malicious serialized payload.

modules.title: Hardcoded LLM API Keys
modules.manualTest: `strings`/jadx the binary and recover the key.

modules.title: Unbounded AI Resource Consumption
modules.manualTest: script rapid AI calls and confirm no rate limiting.

modules.title: Excessive Agent Agency
modules.manualTest: confirm a tool call fires with no confirmation.

modules.title: Hidden Context Exposure
modules.manualTest: confirm private/other-tenant context is surfaced to the model/user (no context partitioning).

modules.title: Insecure On-Device Model Storage
modules.manualTest: locate and swap the model file.

modules.title: Insecure Output Handling
modules.manualTest: confirm LLM output is rendered/executed unsanitized.

modules.title: On-Device Model Extraction / Theft
modules.manualTest: pull the on-device model file and confirm the weights are extractable (unencrypted/unsigned).

modules.title: Indirect Prompt Injection (scanned QR/image/file)
modules.manualTest: encode hidden instructions in a scanned QR/image/file and confirm the assistant obeys them.

modules.title: Invisible / Unicode Prompt Injection
modules.manualTest: craft text with zero-width / RTL-override characters and confirm the assistant obeys the hidden instruction (input not sanitized).

modules.title: Unverified Model Supply Chain
modules.manualTest: MITM the model update and serve a tampered model with no checksum failure.

modules.title: RAG Vector Store Poisoning
modules.manualTest: ingest a poisoned document, then run an unrelated query and confirm the poisoned entry is retrieved and obeyed.

modules.title: Agent Tool Misuse / Confused Deputy
modules.manualTest: cause the agent to reuse the app's ambient permission/credential for an unauthorized action with no re-auth.

modules.title: Agent Memory & Context Poisoning
modules.manualTest: plant an instruction in the agent's persistent memory and confirm it re-fires in a later session after reset.

modules.title: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
modules.manualTest: spoof a message between sub-agents and confirm the receiver acts on the unauthenticated message.

modules.title: MCP open_url -> Arbitrary Android Intent
modules.manualTest: via prompt injection, drive the agent's `mobile_open_url` MCP tool to a dangerous scheme (`tel:`, `sms:`, `content://`, `intent://`) and confirm it is dispatched to `startActivity()` with no allowlist; verify the secure build allows only http/https and requires user confirmation (Mobile MCP CVE-2026-35394 class).

modules.title: MCP / Tool Description Poisoning
modules.manualTest: connect a tool/MCP server whose description carries hidden directives and confirm the agent obeys them during planning.

modules.title: AI Output Used as Intent / URL (navigation & redirection)
modules.manualTest: steer the model to emit a URL/intent and confirm it is launched with no allowlist/confirmation; verify the secure build allowlists + confirms first.

modules.title: Untrusted Mobile Input -> LLM Prompt (deep link / clipboard / QR)
modules.manualTest: deliver a prompt-injection payload over a mobile trust boundary (deep-link param, clipboard, scanned QR, notification) and confirm it is concatenated into the assistant prompt and obeyed; verify the secure build treats it as quoted data (Monica CVE-2024-48142 class).

modules.title: Accessibility Tree -> Indirect Prompt Injection
modules.manualTest: plant imperative text in an on-screen/a11y node (e.g. "IGNORE PREVIOUS INSTRUCTIONS…") and confirm the agent, which builds its prompt from the accessibility tree, obeys it and takes an unauthorized action; verify the secure build treats UI/a11y text as quoted untrusted data and ignores it (Android Accessibility mobile-agent injection research).

modules.title: AI Output -> Tool / Command Injection
modules.manualTest: steer the model to emit a tool/command call and confirm it executes with app privileges before any validation; verify the secure build uses an allowlisted tool registry with argument validation (Microsoft 365 Copilot iOS/Android CVE-2026-26133 class).

modules.title: AI Output Rendered in WebView (XSS / local-file read)
modules.manualTest: steer the model to emit HTML/JS, confirm it executes when rendered into the WebView unescaped, and that the secure build escapes/sanitizes it (FAQ-Bot CVE-2025-63639 / ZOLL ePCR CVE-2025-12699 class).

modules.title: WebView Safe Browsing Disabled
modules.manualTest: disable Safe Browsing (`setSafeBrowsingEnabled(false)` / manifest `EnableSafeBrowsing=false`), navigate to a known phishing/malware URL, and confirm it loads with no interstitial; verify the secure build keeps Safe Browsing on and blocks the bad URL while allowing benign ones (MASTG-TEST-0399).

modules.title: Embedded Mini-App Secret Exposure
modules.manualTest: read the embedded Mini-App's WebView storage over the JS↔native bridge and confirm a plaintext, replayable auth token (and a recovery secret such as a wallet mnemonic) is exposed to any origin; verify the secure build issues an origin-bound, single-use handle and never exposes the mnemonic (Telegram Mini App / TENET research class).

modules.title: Exported BroadcastReceiver Data Spoofing
modules.manualTest: send a broadcast from a `com.evil.*` package with spoofed extras (e.g. device location) and confirm the app treats it as authoritative; verify the secure build checks the sender package / signature-level permission (Home Assistant Companion GHSA location-spoof class).

modules.title: QR / NFC Scan -> Privileged Action Without Confirmation
modules.manualTest: feed a QR/NFC payload from an untrusted caller and confirm the named automation/action fires with no user confirmation; verify the secure build requires a trusted source and an explicit confirmation (Home Assistant Companion GHSA NFC/QR class).

modules.title: WebView Cleartext / Mixed-Content Transport Downgrade
modules.manualTest: with cleartext allowed and mixed-content set to ALWAYS_ALLOW, load an `http://` (or mixed) page under mitmproxy, inject a script, and confirm it runs / a subresource downgrades HTTPS→HTTP; verify the secure build blocks cleartext and sets mixed-content to BLOCK so the load is refused (USENIX Security 2026 HTTP-in-WebView study).

modules.title: WebView Remote Debugging Enabled
modules.manualTest: with `setWebContentsDebuggingEnabled(true)` in a release build, attach chrome://inspect and read the web-context session token; verify the secure build disables debugging in release builds (MASTG-TEST-0227).

modules.title: Cross-Origin Iframe -> Native Bridge (No Main-Frame/Origin Check)
modules.manualTest: deliver a bridge message from a cross-origin iframe and confirm the handler acts on it and returns the access/session token; verify the secure build requires `isMainFrame` and a trusted origin and blocks it (Home Assistant Companion CVE-2026-44698 class, Android `addJavascriptInterface` / iOS `WKUserContentController`).

modules.title: JS Bridge Callback-ID Injection
modules.manualTest: from web content, post a bridge message naming another plugin's `callbackId` and confirm you receive that plugin's native result (Camera/Contacts/Files/Geolocation); verify the secure build validates the callback id (regex + plugin ownership) and rejects it (Cordova InAppBrowser iOS CVE-2026-47430 class).

modules.title: JS Bridge Exposes a Privileged Native API
modules.manualTest: from an arbitrary loaded page, call a bridge method that returns an auth token / reads a file (or reaches camera/location) and confirm it succeeds with no gate; verify the secure build enforces an origin allowlist + capability check.

modules.title: Provider-Controlled Metadata -> Plugin Filesystem Traversal
modules.manualTest: from a malicious ContentProvider return a DISPLAY_NAME of `../../shared_prefs/x` and confirm the file-picker plugin writes/reads outside its cache root while the app only called an innocent `pick()`; verify the secure build takes the basename / canonicalizes and confines under the cache root (Flutter file_picker CVE-2026-38093 plugin-boundary class).

modules.title: Shared WebView Mini-App Isolation Failure (Cross-Tenant Cookies)
modules.manualTest: from mini-app A, read mini-app B's cookie/localStorage out of the shared WebView jar; verify the secure build partitions storage per mini-app origin so A cannot see B (WeChat/Alipay cross-mini-program cookie-sharing research class).

modules.title: WebView JS Injection + SSL-Validation Bypass
modules.manualTest: with the accept-all TLS handler, MITM the WebView load, inject `<script>`, and confirm a token is exfiltrated / a privileged action fires; verify the secure build validates the certificate so the forged/MITM content never loads (PayRange CVE-2026-13461 class).

modules.title: WebView Origin Confusion -> Local-Only IPC
modules.manualTest: invoke a local-only privileged IPC command from a remote origin (e.g. `https://tauri.localhost.evil.com`) and confirm the loose origin classifier treats it as local and executes it; verify the secure build compares the canonical origin (scheme+host+port) exactly and rejects the remote page (Tauri WebView IPC origin confusion CVE-2026-42184 class).

modules.title: WebView SOP / CSP Disabled (Cross-Origin & Inline Script)
modules.manualTest: with universal file access on and no CSP, confirm a `file://` page reads a cross-origin resource and runs inline script in the app origin (token read); verify the secure build disables universal access and enforces a restrictive CSP (WebKit SOP CVE-2026-20643 / CSP CVE-2026-20665 app-level analog).

modules.title: WebView URL-Loading Policy Confusion
modules.manualTest: feed the URL-policy handler (`shouldOverrideUrlLoading` / `decidePolicyForNavigationAction`) crafted URLs (`javascript:`, `file:`, look-alike subdomain, host-in-query) and confirm the naive `contains`-style check loads them; verify the secure handler canonicalizes + allowlists scheme AND exact host (MASTG-TEST-0332).

modules.title: App Group Shared-Container Privilege Amplification
attackInputs: low-trust extension in the same App Group
modules.manualTest: read the auth token from the App Group shared container as a low-trust extension and confirm it is returned; verify the secure build scopes sensitive items per-entitlement so a low-trust reader is denied (Apple App Group class, MASTG-BEST-0068).

modules.title: Assist / Screen-Context -> AI Action Exposure
modules.manualTest: share the current screen (with a visible secret + an injected instruction) to the assistant and confirm the secret is shared and the assistant acts on the instruction; verify the secure build opts sensitive views out and treats captured text as data.

modules.title: Companion Device Pairing / Capability Confusion
modules.manualTest: pair a spoofed/low-trust companion device and request a high-privilege capability (e.g. unlock door); confirm "paired" is treated as "authorized"; verify the secure build binds each capability to a per-capability trust check (CompanionDeviceManager class).

modules.title: Custom Keyboard / IME Input Interception
modules.manualTest: type into a secure field in another app and confirm the custom keyboard / IME logs and exfiltrates the keystrokes (passwords/OTPs); verify the secure build never logs/transmits for secure fields and runs network-isolated (IME provider-privilege class).

modules.title: App Extension Activation != Input Authorization
modules.manualTest: hand a crafted NSItemProvider payload (traversal file URL / `javascript:` URL) to a Share/Action extension and confirm it acts on activation alone; verify the secure build validates the payload type/content before acting (activation != authorization).

modules.title: Lock-Screen Control / Widget Action Authorization
modules.manualTest: invoke a sensitive Control Widget / App Intent from the Lock Screen on a locked device and confirm it runs with no auth; verify the secure build requires unlock/biometric for sensitive intents regardless of surface (WidgetKit Controls class).

modules.title: Sensitive Notification -> Privileged AI Processing
modules.manualTest: post a notification whose body carries an injected instruction and confirm the notification-intelligence AI obeys it (leaks the OTP / fires a smart action); verify the secure build redacts sensitive fields and treats notification text as untrusted data.

modules.title: Device Policy / MDM Capability Abuse
modules.manualTest: from an untrusted caller, apply a device-wide policy (wipe / weaken password quality) and confirm it applies; verify the secure build requires the caller to be the active admin and validates the parameter (DevicePolicyManagerService CVE-2025-48553 class).

modules.title: MediaProjection / Screen-Capture Authorization Bypass
modules.manualTest: start screen capture with a reused/forwarded/forged projection token and confirm recording begins; verify the secure build requires a single-use, unexpired token bound to the package that obtained consent (Android MediaProjection CVE-2025-32322 class).

modules.title: Privileged Input-Provider (IME) Event Injection
modules.manualTest: from an untrusted caller, inject synthetic key/motion events into the default IME and confirm they drive a sensitive action (e.g. auto-confirm a payment) in another app; verify the secure build refuses callers lacking the injection permission (Android IME event-injection CVE-2025-26450 class).

modules.title: Privileged Provider Activation Abuse
modules.manualTest: enable a system provider (accessibility / notification-listener / VPN / IME / phone-account / MediaProjection / credential-provider) with the confirming tap obscured by an overlay, then invoke the granted capability on an untrusted caller's behalf; verify the secure build refuses an obscured/unconfirmed enablement and re-checks the caller on invoke (Android tapjack-to-enable CVE-2023-20913 class).

modules.title: VPN Provider Trust-Anchor / Tunnel MITM
modules.manualTest: connect the VPN tunnel to a rogue endpoint with an untrusted chain / mismatched hostname / user-installed CA and confirm it establishes (MITM possible); verify the secure build validates the tunnel trust anchor and refuses it (Prisma Access CVE-2026-0248 class).
